note: Rejected transactions (b-d) have no tx hash by design: the node refuses them at validation and they are never included in a block. See nonce/balance evidence per entry.

proofs.label: a) scoped call add_message on guestbook (function-call key)
b) NEAR transfer with function-call key (must be rejected)
proofs.expected: rejected by the network (InvalidTxError, access-key permission)
proofs.actual: node rejection: AccessKeyRequiresFullAccessActionError: Access key requires full access
proofs.note: Rejected transactions are never included in a block, so no tx hash / explorer link exists. Nonce unchanged proves nothing was recorded.
